META_YEAR.note: Same font/size/color as META_CATEGORY, but NOT on the same row -- it sits inside the DECOR_RULER cluster, well below the category. RESYNCED: shipped as .project-hero__ruler-year, absolutely positioned at the ruler's own local (14,100), no longer in the .project-hero__meta flex row.
META_YEAR.knownGap: The ruler (and this year label) sits at a fixed position measured against the PSD's 2-line reference title. A project whose title is short enough to render as ONE line leaves the flow-positioned DESC much higher than in the reference, and it can visually overlap this fixed-position ruler/year -- confirmed live on a real project (ui-16ienxj, whose title fits on one line at 1920px). The PSD does not define what should happen for a short title, so this is left as-is (matching the confirmed 2-line reference exactly) rather than inventing an unconfirmed repositioning rule; flagged for the user to decide (always author 2-line titles, or request a follow-up rule for the short-title case).

gradientOverlay.note: RESYNCED: shipped as a 2-stop `linear-gradient(180deg, rgb(24,255,0) 0%, rgb(244,245,250) 100%)` text-fill. Alpha-compositing an opacity-fading green over a solid white base (normal blend mode, confirmed in the PSD layer's own blendMode field) is mathematically identical to a plain green-to-white color interpolation, so this is a faithful translation, not an approximation of the visual result -- just a simpler DOM for it (no duplicate text layers needed). Direction (180deg = top-to-bottom in CSS) is a best-effort translation of Photoshop's angle=90+reverse=true convention -- verified by eye against the reference (line 1 reads more saturated green, line 2 more pale), not from a documented exact angle-convention mapping; flagged as the one remaining soft spot in this element's fidelity.

DECOR_ORB_RIGHT.note: RESYNCED: shipped as `linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(24,255,0,0.92) 0%, rgba(24,255,0,0) 100%)` -- a single color fading via opacity (the PSD's second color stop is moot once opacity reaches 0, so this is a faithful single-color-fade translation, not a 2-color blend). Direction (135deg, a diagonal) is a best-effort translation of Photoshop's angle=54+reverse=true; the exact angle-to-CSS-degree mapping is not independently verified, only checked by eye against the reference render.

Verified live: bracket/dot/year/tick positions all match the PSD's measured (x,y) exactly at a true 1920px viewport (this requred the .project-hero full-bleed fix above -- see implementationNote on this section).
DECOR_RULER.ticksNote: PSD's 12 tick marks have a ~44px pitch with a couple of manual-placement outliers and alternate between 32px/43px heights. Shipped as one uniform, evenly-spaced repeating-linear-gradient pattern (using the taller 43px height, ~44px pitch) rather than hand-placing each measured outlier -- reproducing the ruler's repeating-tick design intent rather than overfitting placement noise that reads as unintentional.
